tasks.description: Implement logic to calculate and display discounted prices. Original prices are rendered with text-decoration: line-through if a discount is present.
acceptance_criteria: 'Car' model must define 'discount_percentage' as an integer field with default value 0.
'POST /api/cars' must persist a provided 'discount_percentage' value as an integer.
'PUT /api/cars/:id' must persist a provided 'discount_percentage' value as an integer.
'AddCarPage' must render a 'Discount (%)' number input with id='car-discount-input' in the pricing/details step.
'AddCarPage' must include the entered discount value in the submitted 'POST /api/cars' request body.
'EditCarPage' must pre-fill the discount input from the car's persisted 'discount_percentage'.
'EditCarPage' must include the edited discount value in the submitted 'PUT /api/cars/:id' request body.
'CarCard' must render a discount badge with '<discount_percentage>% OFF' when 'discount_percentage' is greater than 0 and less than 100.
'CarCard' must render the rounded discounted price when 'discount_percentage' is greater than 0 and less than 100.
'CarCard' must render the original price as a line-through value when a valid discount is present.
'CarDetailsPage' Overview tab must render a discount badge with '<discount_percentage>% OFF' when a valid discount is present.
'CarDetailsPage' Overview acquisition card must render the original price as a line-through value when a valid discount is present.
'CarDetailsPage' Price tab must render the discount deduction amount as original price minus discounted price.
'PurchaseModal' must render the rounded final discounted price when a valid discount is present.
'PurchaseModal' must render an 'Offer' value of '<discount_percentage>% OFF' when a valid discount is present.
'PurchaseModal' must render the original price as a line-through value when a valid discount is present.
'AdminDashboard' Vehicles tab must render the discounted display price for a discounted car.
'AdminDashboard' Bookings tab must render the discounted display price for a booking whose car has a valid discount.
'HomePage' must render '#homepage-discounts-section' when the API returns at least one car with a valid discount.
'HomePage' must render no more than six discounted car banners.
'HomePage' must render each discounted car banner as a link to '/car/<car._id>'.
'HomePage' must render each discount banner with '<discount_percentage>% OFF' badge text and the rounded discounted price.
'HomePage' must render each discount banner's original price as a line-through value.
'CarCard' must not render a discount badge when 'discount_percentage' is 0.
'CarCard' must render the original price, not a discounted price, when 'discount_percentage' is 100.
'CarDetailsPage' Overview tab must not render a discount badge when 'discount_percentage' is 0.
'CarDetailsPage' Price tab must not render a discount row when 'discount_percentage' is 0.
'CarDetailsPage' Overview tab must render the original acquisition price, not a discounted price, when 'discount_percentage' is negative.
'PurchaseModal' must not render the 'Offer' section when 'discount_percentage' is 0.
'PurchaseModal' must render the original price and no discount offer when 'discount_percentage' is 100.
'AdminDashboard' Vehicles tab must render the original price when 'discount_percentage' is 0.
'AdminDashboard' Bookings tab must render the original booking car price when 'discount_percentage' is 100.
'HomePage' must not render a discount banner for a seeded car with 'discount_percentage' 0.
